notes: Gen1Recomp now comes with the update. The Ports tab is ready the moment the console restarts, with no download and nothing to press, and it works offline. This is Gen1Recomp 0.1.95 by bryanthaboi, included with their permission. If you have a Gen 1 Pokemon Game Boy ROM, Red, Blue, Yellow and Gold appear as their own tiles and launch straight into the game. Each game is prepared from your own ROM the first time you start it, which takes a few seconds, and it is prepared again after a Gen1Recomp update so a tile can never open on the port's "ROM required" screen. Games open fullscreen. Mods still install from the Ports tab of the console's web page on port 8097.
